name: Driver
definition: A Formula 1 driver who participates in races; one row per driver in tab03.
scope: Driver-centric analysis: identity, nationality, birth date, race participation and results.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 constructor (team or manufacturer); one row per constructor in tab02.
scope: Constructor identity, nationality and per-race points.

name: Circuit
definition: A motorsport circuit venue where races are held; one row per circuit in tab01.
scope: Venue location, country and coordinates.

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 Grand Prix event held in a season at a circuit; one row in tab05.
scope: Race identity, season, round, circuit and date.

name: Season
definition: A Formula 1 championship year; one row per year in tab04.
scope: Season-level analysis and year filtering.

name: Race Status
definition: The classification status of a race result, such as Finished, Disqualified, Accident, Engine or Collision; tab12.
scope: Interpreting why a driver did or did not finish.

name: Race Result
definition: One driver's classified result in one race, including finishing position, points, laps and race time; one row per driver per race in tab13.
scope: Per-race driver performance and finish analysis.

name: Driver Standing
definition: A driver's cumulative championship standing after a race; one row per driver per race in tab08.
scope: Championship points, position and wins over time.

name: Constructor Race Result
definition: A constructor's aggregated points result for one race; one row per constructor per race in tab06.
scope: Per-race constructor points and zero-point races.

name: Lap Time Record
definition: One lap completed by one driver in one race, with lap number, position, formatted time and milliseconds; tab09.
scope: Lap-by-lap pace, average lap time and fastest lap analysis.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: One driver's qualifying session result for a race, including Q1/Q2/Q3 times and qualifying position; tab11.
scope: Qualifying pace and grid determination.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: The driver's full personal name, formed from forename and surname.
scope: Use when a question asks for the name of a driver.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: The driver's nationality, stored as an adjective such as British, German, French, Japanese or Dutch.
scope: Nationality filtering and counting of drivers.

name: Driver Birth Date
definition: The driver's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Birth-year and age-based selection.

name: Driver Age
definition: Driver age at a reference time, derived from birth date; ordering by birth date determines youngest and oldest drivers, with the youngest having the latest birth date.
scope: Age comparisons such as youngest or oldest racer.

name: Driver Code
definition: The driver's short three-letter abbreviation, such as HAM or MSC; it may be empty for some historical drivers.
scope: Identifying a driver by abbreviated code.

name: Driver Reference Name
definition: The driver's reference slug, such as hamilton or michael_schumacher.
scope: Identifying a driver by reference name.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: The constructor's nationality, stored as an adjective such as Japanese or German.
scope: Nationality filtering and counting of constructors.

name: Constructor Reference Name
definition: The constructor's reference slug, such as mclaren or ferrari.
scope: Identifying a constructor by reference name.

name: Constructor Website
definition: The constructor's website or reference URL.
scope: Returning a constructor's website.

name: Circuit Reference Name
definition: The circuit's reference slug, such as marina_bay or sepang.
scope: Identifying a circuit by reference name.

name: Circuit Location
definition: The city or locality of the circuit.
scope: Reporting where a circuit is situated.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country where the circuit is located; used to determine where a race was hosted.
scope: Country-based filtering of circuits and races.

name: Circuit Coordinates
definition: The geographic coordinates of the circuit: latitude and longitude.
scope: Coordinate-location questions about a circuit.

name: Race Name
definition: The official name of the race, such as European Grand Prix or Singapore Grand Prix.
scope: Race-name filtering and reporting.

name: Race Date
definition: The calendar date on which the race was held, in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Date, month and year filtering of races.

name: Race Round
definition: The race's round number within its season.
scope: Ordering races inside a season.

name: Race Year
definition: The championship year in which a race took place (tab05.fld020).
scope: Year filtering on race rows.

name: Season Year
definition: The championship year key of a season (tab04.fld020).
scope: Season-level year filtering and joins from races to seasons.

name: Constructor Race Points
definition: Points scored by a constructor in a single race (tab06.fld026).
scope: Per-race constructor scoring and zero-point races.

name: Driver Standing Points
definition: Cumulative championship points of a driver after a race (tab08.fld026).
scope: Driver championship points and maximum point scores.

name: Standing Position
definition: A driver's championship position after a race (tab08.fld029).
scope: Championship ranking and season champion identification.

name: Driver Wins
definition: Cumulative number of race wins for a driver (tab08.fld031); it can also be counted from first-place race results.
scope: Identifying the most-winning driver.

name: Race Position
definition: A driver's finishing position in a race (tab13.fld029); positionOrder fld044 gives the official classified order.
scope: Race finishing order and winner identification.

name: Fastest Lap Rank
definition: The rank of a driver's fastest lap within the race (tab13.fld047); it is 0 or NULL when no rank is recorded.
scope: Fastest-lap ranking, never race finishing order.

name: Fastest Lap Number
definition: The lap number on which a driver set their fastest lap (tab13.fld046).
scope: Identifying when a fastest lap occurred.

name: Fastest Lap Time
definition: The fastest lap time recorded by a driver in a race (tab13.fld048, format M:SS.mmm); it can also be derived as the minimum lap time.
scope: Fastest-lap comparisons.

name: Lap Time in Milliseconds
definition: A lap's duration expressed in milliseconds (tab09.fld034); the numeric basis for comparing lap times.
scope: Numeric lap-time comparison and thresholds.

name: Average Lap Time
definition: The mean lap duration for a driver in a race, derived from lap milliseconds.
scope: Average pace analysis for a driver and race.

name: Laps Completed
definition: The number of laps completed by a driver in a race (tab13.fld045).
scope: Race distance completed by a driver.

name: Race Completion Rate
definition: The share of race entries that were completed, where completed means having a non-null race time, relative to all entries in scope; usually expressed as a percentage.
scope: Completion-rate questions over a driver or race subset.

name: Percentage Share
definition: A ratio of a counted subset to a corresponding total, multiplied by 100 and expressed as a percentage.
scope: Percentage questions over races, drivers or results.

name: Qualifying Q3 Time
definition: The driver's Q3 lap time in qualifying (tab11.fld040, format M:SS.mmm); it is NULL when no Q3 time was set.
scope: Q3 pace and qualifying-order questions.

name: Race Winner
definition: The driver who finished first in a race, identified by race position or positionOrder equal to 1.
scope: Race-level champion/winner questions.

name: Season Champion
definition: The driver with championship standing position 1 at the final race of a season.
scope: Season-level champion questions.
